tb21_profile.skill: Drive an embedding-model API correctly (named model at a pinned revision), encode a query and a line-per-document corpus, rank by cosine similarity and return the k-th ranked item exactly
tb21_profile.domain: Text embeddings / semantic retrieval: mteb, sentence-transformers, HuggingFace model revisions, numpy cosine similarity
tb21_profile.task_form: implement-from-spec with a single exactly-pinned output line; the difficulty is API-correctness plus off-by-one/ordering discipline, not algorithm design

verifier_notes: No grade I checked looked wrong. Every SWE-side candidate is repo-tests. All ten Recursive-Task-Synthesis picks are 'absent' (whole corpus), and its best offering — the CADE cosine-similarity family — has a graded twin in TerminalWorld (tw_323887, 'ok'), so I put the graded twin in final_top10 and left the RTS variants in per_source only. FREE candidates excluded from both lists where alternatives existed: tw_744060, tw_326628, tw_733941, task_003033_b68d0a3b, data-science_20260615_143301_004, model-training_20260617_051646_004.

notes: This TB2.1 task is unusually well covered: TMax-15K has a whole family of sentence-transformers retrieval tasks (task_003184_6024c47e is effectively the same problem with all-MiniLM-L6-v2) and CalibForge contributes the two sharpest skill matches for the parts that actually break agents — taking the k-th ranked item with tie rules (data-science_20260607_104421_004) and ranked-list metric edge cases (data-science_20260604_004411_008). Neither of those was near the top of the lexical order. Recursive-Task-Synthesis offers only the CADE semantic-shift family: genuinely on-domain but all 'absent'-graded and heavily diluted by git/HTTP-config subtasks, so it is represented in per_source only. TerminalWorld is the weakest corpus here: exactly one on-topic task (tw_323887); ranks 2-10 are padding and their overall scores say so, and three of its higher-RRF hits were FREE. SWE-Smith's honest contribution is the textdistance/strsimpy pair — real cosine-similarity implementation bugs — and nothing else in that pool is close. SWE-Rebench contributes embedding-API and model-loading bugs in the HuggingFace/litellm ecosystem; correct domain, wrong task_form, as expected.
